case_workflow.goal: Keep Pi compaction behavior model-aware, canonical, correctly timed, and recoverable without claiming the Hermes/DeepSeek shared-capacity invariant.
conditional_branches: If the active model has an exact provider/model override, use it; otherwise use ordinary settings and then defaults.
If projected context exceeds contextWindow - reserveTokens, compact before the next assistant request.
If a tool result terminates the turn, do not schedule an unnecessary next-request compaction.
If provider usage is unavailable or all-zero, fall back to message estimation; if a trailing artifact exceeds keepRecentTokens, retain a safe assistant boundary.
stopping_conditions: No compaction when disabled or below threshold.
No provider request starts with projected context above the active threshold after successful compaction.
No extra compaction after a terminating tool result.
Do not promote this workflow to a direct cross-repository Pattern without evidence of shared output-headroom arithmetic.
